purpose: Disclosed selection of an illustrative factual success, not an accuracy benchmark
selection_rule: Eligible only if the target is one tokenizer token, is not top-1 at step 0, and is top-1 at step 143000. Prefer france_original, then paris_country, then france_possessive if eligible; otherwise select the eligible candidate with highest final target probability, breaking ties by declared list order. If either endpoint is absent, make no recommendation. This selection is curated for an illustrative success and must not be presented as representative accuracy.
